context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:

<name>: EVIDENCE=direct|indirect|indeterminate; FRAME=<1-96 or none>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 15 words>
direct = contact visibly occurs (door meets body); indirect = aftermath/motion implies it but the touch isn't seen; indeterminate = cannot tell.

Image 2: sedan-door-swing
Image 3: yt-7g18ntq8qf0-tesla-sentry-mode-right-camera-car-doors-ope
